title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 3: C1 COMMUNICATION EXPANSION
description: A high-level communication world that moves learners from accurate advanced English toward flexible, precise, independent C1 communication across social, academic, and professional contexts.

targets.vocabulary: 3000+ active words with collocations, idiomatic language, phrasal verbs, and domain-specific vocabulary
targets.reading: 1800–2200 words with inference, stance, tone, and implicit meaning
targets.listening: 18–22 minutes of authentic speech with varied accents and discourse styles
targets.speaking: 22–28 minutes of sustained interaction, explanation, discussion, and spontaneous response
targets.writing: 600–800 words with clear argumentation, cohesion, nuance, and register control
targets.presentation: 10–14 minute structured presentation with follow-up questions

grammar: Advanced tense and aspect choices for emphasis, sequencing, and viewpoint
Modal verbs and modal perfects for certainty, criticism, probability, and speculation
Mixed and complex conditionals in analytical and hypothetical contexts
Advanced passive, reporting structures, and impersonal constructions
Participle clauses, reduced clauses, and dense noun phrases
Inversion, fronting, clefting, and information structure
Ellipsis, substitution, and reference for concise discourse
Advanced linking, concession, contrast, and cause-effect patterns
Hedging, stance, politeness, and pragmatic precision

missions.title: Lexical Precision Lab
missions.focus: collocations, semantic shades, word families, and precision vocabulary
missions.challenge: Choose language that communicates exact meaning rather than approximate meaning.

missions.title: Aspect & Viewpoint Mastery
missions.focus: advanced tense and aspect choices
missions.challenge: Explain how tense and aspect change emphasis, sequence, and speaker viewpoint.

missions.title: Probability & Evidence Lab
missions.focus: modal verbs, modal perfects, deduction, and evidence
missions.challenge: Express degrees of certainty and evaluate evidence with precise modal language.

missions.title: Hypothesis Architect
missions.focus: mixed conditionals and complex hypothetical reasoning
missions.challenge: Build accurate hypothetical explanations about past, present, and future consequences.

missions.title: Reporting Reality
missions.focus: passive reporting, impersonal reporting, and source attribution
missions.challenge: Transform direct claims into neutral, formal, and evidence-aware reporting.

missions.title: Complex Sentence Forge
missions.focus: participial clauses, reduced relatives, apposition, and dense noun phrases
missions.challenge: Combine ideas into sophisticated sentences without losing clarity.

missions.title: Information Focus Lab
missions.focus: cleft sentences, inversion, fronting, and emphasis
missions.challenge: Control what listeners notice first and create deliberate information focus.

missions.title: Cohesion Intelligence
missions.focus: reference, substitution, ellipsis, discourse markers, and paragraph flow
missions.challenge: Connect complex ideas naturally without repetitive or mechanical linking.

missions.title: Nuance & Hedging Arena
missions.focus: hedging, stance, degrees of commitment, and diplomatic language
missions.challenge: Express disagreement and uncertainty without becoming vague or unnatural.

missions.title: Pragmatics Control Room
missions.focus: politeness, indirectness, implied meaning, and social context
missions.challenge: Select language that fits relationship, situation, intention, and cultural expectations.

missions.title: Reading Between the Lines
missions.focus: implicit meaning, author stance, tone, bias signals, and inference
missions.challenge: Identify conclusions that are suggested rather than directly stated.

missions.title: Authentic Listening Mission
missions.focus: fast speech, reduced forms, discourse shifts, and speaker attitude
missions.challenge: Track meaning when speakers change topic, qualify claims, or speak spontaneously.

missions.title: Critical Writing Lab
missions.focus: argument, counterargument, synthesis, evidence, and conclusion
missions.challenge: Build a balanced argument that acknowledges alternatives and reaches a justified conclusion.

missions.title: Professional Writing Upgrade
missions.focus: formal email, report language, recommendations, and executive summaries
missions.challenge: Deliver complex information clearly for a professional audience.

missions.title: Presentation Intelligence
missions.focus: signposting, emphasis, examples, transitions, and audience adaptation
missions.challenge: Present a complex topic clearly while adapting explanations to audience needs.

missions.title: Negotiation & Mediation Lab
missions.focus: persuasion, compromise, clarification, and diplomatic problem solving
missions.challenge: Reach a workable agreement while protecting key priorities and relationships.

missions.title: Media & Society Analysis
missions.focus: media language, technology, social change, and competing interpretations
missions.challenge: Compare viewpoints and explain how language shapes public interpretation.

missions.title: Academic & Workplace Simulation
missions.focus: seminars, meetings, evidence-based discussion, and professional collaboration
missions.challenge: Participate actively while asking precise questions, challenging ideas, and building on others.

missions.title: World 3 Integrated Marathon
missions.focus: integrated reading, listening, speaking, writing, grammar, and vocabulary
missions.challenge: Complete a multi-stage C1-style communication mission with limited support.

missions.title: WORLD 3 MASTER QUEST — C1 COMMUNICATION EXPANSION
missions.focus: full-world mastery assessment
missions.challenge: Demonstrate precise, flexible, coherent, and independent English across complex real-world tasks.

realWorldScenarios: Participating in a university-style seminar and responding to challenging questions
Leading a workplace discussion where participants have conflicting priorities
Explaining and evaluating information from two competing sources
Writing a recommendation report for a practical decision
Negotiating a solution while maintaining a professional relationship
Giving a presentation and responding spontaneously to audience follow-up questions

assessment.masteryGoal: Learner can communicate complex ideas accurately, flexibly, coherently, and appropriately with increasing C1 independence.
